events.text: my car battery is dead and i have an early shift, anyone have jumper cables?
I’ll quickly ask awake neighbors who may be able to help.
A car battery is dead before an early shift. Do you have jumper cables?
A neighbor’s car battery is dead and they have an early shift. Do you have jumper cables?
A neighbor needs jumper cables for a dead car battery before an early shift. Do you have a set?

No. Got tools, cords, ladder, tape — no jumper cables. If you need, I can come help push-start if it's manual; otherwise I can try to buy cables today — got about 200 SAR, can haggle. When do you need it?
No problem bro — I’ve got jumper cables in my car. Want me to come down now and jump it?
Sorry, I don't— I don't have jumper cables. I can offer tea and honey while you wait, or help call someone who can bring a set.
I'll relay Hamza's immediate offer and the other available help.
Hamza has jumper cables and can come down now—I'd recommend him as the fastest option! Sulaiman can help push-start a manual car, and Asma can help call someone; which would you like?
Hamza, please
I’ll arrange the jump-start and release the other helpers.
Thanks! Can you meet Noor by her car downstairs now to jump-start it?
Help is arranged. Thanks for offering.
Help is arranged, thank you for offering.
I’ve asked Hamza to meet you by your car downstairs now. I’ll confirm when he replies!
On my way — downstairs in about 5 minutes. Tell Noor to pop the bonnet and stay near the driver's seat. Let's go.
Good. Keep warm — I’m around if you need tools or a hand later.
You're welcome — glad it's sorted. I'll put the kettle on and leave a mug by the door in case they stop by.
Yes please, go with your recommendation
Confirming Hamza’s arrival with Noor.
Hamza is on his way and will meet you by your car downstairs in about 5 minutes! He asks you to pop the bonnet and stay near the driver’s seat.
